title: Blog post: pick a cover image
subtitle: For the post about learning to bake bread at home.

project.summary: The draft is ready. It needs a cover and a title before it goes out.

items.title: Which cover image?
items.why: The cover is what people see in feeds and link previews.

details.context: All three were made for this post at 1440 by 896 pixels. The page shows small copies; the links open nothing outside this page.
details.recommendation: The warm landscape matches the tone of the post and still reads at thumbnail size.

options.label: Warm landscape
options.alt: A warm sunset over dark hills

options.label: Title as type
options.alt: The word Title in large serif type
options.preview: Uses the post title in large serif letters.
cons: Text is hard to read in a small preview

items.title: Which headline?
items.why: The headline is also the link text when the post is shared.

details.context: Most visits to the blog come from search and from shared links, where only the headline and the cover show.
details.recommendation: The plain one tells a reader what they get. The question works only for people who already have the problem.

options.label: Baking bread at home, week by week
options.preview: Says what the post is. 36 characters.

options.label: Why does my bread not rise?
options.preview: Answers the question most readers search for.

items.title: Anything to change in the draft?
